content: Locked enterprise target: durable custody, placement, continuity and recovery for enterprise data. Mining is an optional tenant/workload, not the product's identity. Status: target authority documented from the newer enterprise triad; legacy projection mapping, exact API and current runtime qualification open. ## Owned obligations Durable custody, replicas, healing, journals, quotas, provenance and lifecycle coordination. Ovid owns versioned transformation/materialisation; Chronus owns eligible acceleration without digest changes; AL HARAS remains security/policy authority. Theseus emits and enforces integrated policy hooks, not an independent policy root. ## Technical contract baseline | Operation family | Required obligation | | --- | --- | | Custody admission | Bind tenant/policy, object identity, schema lineage, quota and durability requirements | | Durable write/read | Record acknowledged durability level and consistency scope; verify stored/materialised identity; do not acknowledge stronger guarantees than the deployment provides | | Replicate / heal / recover | Explicit placement/recovery evidence, failure state and provenance continuity; no silent authority switch | | Migration / reopen | Version-aware lineage, authenticity and degradation policy; fail closed on incompatible or unverifiable state | Historical surfaces: theseus, aethel.triad, aethel.enterprise.EnterpriseCustody, journal and lifecycle composition, plus distributed/solutions integration. These are source references, not a complete current function/HTTP schema. Pin the exact package and fixtures before ABI freeze. SHA-256 is integrity; HMAC is authenticity. Production authentication must not silently use a default key; key identity/rotation and fail-closed verification are explicit conditions. ## Legacy split An older SALAMANDER adapter describes THESEUS/hyba\_db as a rebuildable projection. That adapter must be version-mapped or migrated explicitly; this enterprise custody charter does not retroactively make every historical projection authoritative. ## Non-mining acceptance requirement Store and restore a tenant-scoped enterprise artifact across restart; verify replica/heal/journal behaviour, quota refusal, corruption detection, key rotation and declared failure semantics. Test simultaneous writer contention separately from attach/reopen. Historical 67 tests, local nodes, simulated regions and 50 light-endurance operations do not establish physical WAN, hyperscaler production or soak qualification. ## Customer schedule Specify exact durability/consistency level, topology, backup/restore responsibilities, RPO/RTO only if tested and contracted, region/residency, retention/deletion and customer key obligations. No blanket zero-loss or compliance certification. Approved license, pricing, support/SLA and DPA remain separate. ## Mining boundary May hold authorised workload data and evidence; does not own block correctness, pool acceptance, keys/wallet operations or reward accounting by virtue of custody. ## Source traceability - feat(aethel): Chronus·Theseus·Ovid enterprise custody substrate - #108 SALAMANDER_AUTONOMIC_CONTROL_PLANE - HYBA — Enterprise Product Lock Register
